items.description: Five shared text styles for rendered markdown and rich-text editors. Wrap content in .typeset; add .typeset-compact for compact density, or .not-typeset to opt a subtree out. items.name: size-context
items.title: Size Context
items.description: React context provider for the two-step size ladder (36px default, 28px compact). Controls control heights, text, icon, and padding scale across all Fluid Functionalism components, and exports the role-based typography scale.

items.name: font-weight
items.title: Font Weight Tokens
items.description: Variable font weight tokens for Inter (normal, medium, semibold, bold) using font-variation-settings.

items.name: surface-context
items.title: Surface Context
items.description: React context that tracks the current substrate elevation level. Elevated components (Dropdown, Select, etc.) read it via useSurface() and render at substrate + offset, then re-provide a new substrate so further nesting elevates further.

items.name: surface-classes
items.title: Surface Class Lookup
items.description: Static lookup tables for bg-surface-N and shadow-surface-N utilities. Required because Tailwind v4 cannot detect template-literal class names.

items.name: elevated
items.title: Elevated
items.description: Elevation primitive. Wraps the read-substrate / compute-level / apply-classes / re-provide-context pattern into one component. Pulls in the surface theme tokens, substrate context, and class lookup so a single install drops in the whole elevation system.

items.name: shape-context
items.title: Shape Context
items.description: Radius variants with progressive superellipse(1.5) corners, round fallbacks, and explicit circular scopes.

html.transitioning *, html.transitioning.transition: border-radius 180ms ease-in-out, background-color 180ms ease-in-out, color 180ms ease-in-out, border-color 180ms ease-in-out, fill 180ms ease-in-out, stroke 180ms ease-in-out !important

items.name: icon-context
items.title: Icon Context
items.description: Named icon slots with a Lucide default set; swap any icon via IconProvider.

items.name: icon-map
items.title: Icon Map
items.description: Canonical icon name mapping across Lucide, Tabler, Phosphor, HugeIcons, and Untitled UI.

items.name: use-proximity-hover
items.title: useProximityHover
items.description: React hook for proximity-based hover detection. Tracks the closest item to the mouse cursor within a container, enabling smooth animated background indicators.

items.name: use-merge-split
items.title: useMergeSplitBlocks
items.description: React hook + renderer for the selected-background merge/split animation. When one row bridges or splits two contiguous selected runs, their inner edges glide together (or apart) and swap to a single block, instead of one block spring-growing over the union.

items.name: use-touch-primary
items.title: useTouchPrimary
items.description: Detects touch-primary devices (coarse pointer + touch points), updating live on pointer-mode and media-query changes. Adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: Scroll container with a restyled overlay scrollbar that stays discoverable on hover and follows the shape system. Falls back to native overflow scrolling on touch-primary devices. Built on Radix UI Scroll Area; adapted from Lina (https://lina.sameer.sh).

items.description: Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Radix flavor.
items.docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/sidebar. Related blocks: sidebar-app, sidebar-workspace-header, sidebar-user-footer.

items.name: sidebar-base
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: Refined, composable app sidebar with offcanvas collapse, floating and inset variants, a mobile drawer, cookie-persisted state, keyboard shortcut, and fluid-hover menus with traveling selection, hover, and focus indicators. Base UI flavor.
items.docs: Docs & live playground: https://www.fluidfunctionalism.com/docs/sidebar. Related blocks: sidebar-app, sidebar-workspace-header, sidebar-user-footer.

items.name: mobile-drawer
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Radix flavor.

items.name: mobile-drawer-base
items.title: Mobile Drawer
items.description: Slide-in navigation drawer with scrim, focus trap, and scroll lock. Base UI flavor.

items.name: file-thumbnail
items.title: File Thumbnail
items.description: Read-only square preview of a File. Images render via object-cover; PDFs render their first page via pdfjs; a spinner shows while either resolves. Adapts its corner radius to the global shape setting.

items.name: dialog-sidebar
items.title: Settings Dialog (Sidebar in a Dialog)
items.description: A settings dialog: the xl Dialog as a canvas, a non-collapsing Sidebar of sections down its left edge, and a scrolling panel of controls — switches, selects, and an input group. Below the sm breakpoint a Select takes over navigation.

items.name: sidebar-app
items.title: App Sidebar
items.description: A complete app shell: workspace header with the peek cross-fade, search on the menu rows' rhythm with a hover-revealed shortcut chip, collapsible sections with label actions and badges, a user footer, and an inset topbar whose trigger fades back in at its settled position after a pin.

items.name: sidebar-workspace-header
items.title: Sidebar Workspace Header
items.description: Workspace brand row for a sidebar header: 20px tile on the rows' leading axis, name pinned to the 32px text axis, trigger cross-fading into the tile's slot while the collapsed rail peeks, and a trigger-width switcher menu on the shared sidebar grid.

items.name: sidebar-user-footer
items.title: Sidebar User Footer
items.description: Footer identity row: a 20px avatar centred on the rows' leading icon axis, chevron on the trailing action axis, and an upward user menu on the shared sidebar grid so its rows align with the trigger exactly.

items.name: sidebar-search-field
items.title: Sidebar Search Field
items.description: Header search on the menu rows' rhythm: leading icon on the rows' 16px axis, text on the 32px axis, and a hover-revealed keystroke chip at the trailing edge.

items.name: sidebar-inset-topbar
items.title: Sidebar Inset Topbar
items.description: The main region's topbar: h-12 with the trigger that hides while the rail peeks and fades back in at its settled spot after a pin.

items.name: use-keyboard-nav-gate
items.title: useKeyboardNavGate
items.description: Gates a popup's keyboard focus ring on keyboard use: seeded at open from the focused element's :focus-visible state, then earned by navigation keys inside the popup.

items.name: popup
items.title: Popup chrome
items.description: Shared popup chrome for the dropdown, select, and combobox popups: side-aware enter/exit motion classes driven by the positioner's resolved data-side, the ScrollArea sizing the list scrolls inside, and the navigation-key list.

items.name: tokens
items.title: Interaction Tokens
items.description: Shared interaction-state tokens: surface-relative hover/active overlays (bg-hover, bg-active), the selected fill, the destructive-light ground, the --overlay RGB triplet, the --focus-ring color, and the base-layer :focus-visible fallback ring.

items.name: command-menu
items.title: Command Menu
items.description: Search field over a list of actions: type to filter, arrows to move the fluid hover highlight, Enter to run. Grouped rows with icons, descriptions, and shortcut caps; suggestions listed first while nothing is typed; subtle tabs or a borderless filter bar under the field; and a dialog shell opened by a global shortcut (default ⌘K / Ctrl+K). The list needs no primitive; the dialog is the library's Dialog in either flavor.

items.name: sidebar-menu-grid
items.title: Sidebar Menu Grid
items.description: Shared popup geometry for sidebar-anchored dropdown menus: trigger width +10px shifted -4px, items on the rows' leading and text axes, trailing glyphs on the trigger chevron's axis.

items.name: banner
items.title: Banner
items.description: Status message built from parts (Banner, BannerTitle, BannerDescription, BannerActions, BannerAction): 5 statuses (filled glyphs for info, success, warning and error; the icon set's outline info icon for default), low or high contrast, primary, secondary and ghost actions (the library Button) that trail a one-line banner (primary at the edge) and drop under a description (primary first), a dismiss that collapses its height, and a fixed variant that sticks full-bleed to the top of the page.
items.docs: Docs & live examples: https://boringui.dev/docs/banner. Adapted from Fluid Functionalism under the MIT License.

items.name: carousel-dots
items.title: Carousel Dots
items.description: Carousel dots, static or on autoplay: fluid-hover click areas, and a current pill that fills over each slide's duration.
items.docs: Docs & live examples: https://boringui.dev/docs/carousel-dots. Adapted from Fluid Functionalism under the MIT License.

items.name: banner-base
items.title: Banner
items.description: Status message built from parts (Banner, BannerTitle, BannerDescription, BannerActions, BannerAction): 5 statuses (filled glyphs for info, success, warning and error; the icon set's outline info icon for default), low or high contrast, primary, secondary and ghost actions (the library Button) that trail a one-line banner (primary at the edge) and drop under a description (primary first), a dismiss that collapses its height, and a fixed variant that sticks full-bleed to the top of the page.
items.docs: Docs & live examples: https://boringui.dev/docs/banner. Adapted from Fluid Functionalism under the MIT License.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: A single chat transcript entry with baked-in entrance and layout motion. Right-aligned accent bubble for the user, left-aligned muted bubble for the assistant, with optional file attachments. Adapts to the global shape setting.

items.name: queued-stack
items.title: Queued message stack
items.description: Sonner-style stack of queued composer messages: collapsed cards fan out on hover (tap on touch), drag to reorder, a gutter arrow counts the overflow, edit/remove per card, and a shared-layout morph into the sent message.

items.name: input-otp
items.title: Input OTP
items.description: One-time code input with native selection, paste, autofill, grouped slots, and validation feedback. Follows the active shape and size.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: Stacked notifications with status feedback, actions, promise updates, six viewport positions, and accessible timer and keyboard handling. Follows the active shape, size, and surface.
